title: elymus novae-angliae
intro: Elymus novae-angliae, commonly known as New England wild rye, is a type of grass native to eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce swelling and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Elymus novae-angliae include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and have a calming effect on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
